label.description: Human-readable name for this debug configuration

program.description: Path to the Dart file to debug. Files ending in `_test.dart` run in the test debug adapter; `path?line=N` runs only the test or group at line N.

cwd.description: Path to the working directory. Defaults to the nearest directory above `program` that contains `pubspec.yaml`.

useFvm.description: Whether to run the Dart/Flutter tool through the `fvm` command. If unset, the SDK in `.fvm/flutter_sdk` is used when `cwd` or one of its parents has `.fvmrc` or `.fvm/fvm_config.json`; `false` always uses the tool from PATH.

args.description: Arguments passed to the Dart program.

toolArgs.description: Arguments passed to the Flutter/Dart tool (e.g. --flavor, -d chrome).

env.description: Environment variables to set when launching the debug adapter.

deviceId.description: The device to launch on, passed to the Flutter tool as `-d <deviceId>`. Ignored if toolArgs already contains -d/--device-id, and for tests outside `integration_test/`. If unset, Flutter auto-picks a device.

vmServiceUri.description: The VM Service URI to attach to (for attach mode)
